$description: VersionCompare (platform/patterns/VersionCompare), library wave 12, lane A: its pattern tokens. The pickers' row; the text diff: its bar, the lines' frame and tallest height, each line's type (the data font), its numbers and sign columns, and the added and removed lines on the existing success and danger soft roles with their signs in the matching content roles; a folded run's fill. Side by side and the slider are ComparisonView's.

version-compare-gap.$description: VersionCompare: the space between the pickers and the comparison (space-stack-md).

version-compare-pickers-gap.$description: VersionCompare: the gap between the pickers, Swap and the views (space-inline-sm).

version-compare-diff-gap.$description: VersionCompare text: the space between the bar and the lines (space-stack-xs).

version-compare-summary-line-height.$description: VersionCompare text: the summary's line height (20px).

version-compare-steps-gap.$description: VersionCompare text: the gap between Previous and Next change (space-inline-xs).

version-compare-lines-max-height.$description: VersionCompare text: the lines' tallest height; past it they scroll (560px).

version-compare-line-gap.$description: VersionCompare text: the gap between a line's numbers, sign and text (space-inline-sm).

version-compare-line-padding-inline.$description: VersionCompare text: a line's padding at the start and end (space-inset-sm).

version-compare-line-font-family.$description: VersionCompare text: the lines compare text exactly: the data font (Reddit Mono).

version-compare-number-width.$description: VersionCompare text: a line-number column's width (32px).

version-compare-number-text.$description: VersionCompare text: the line numbers' color (content-subtle).

version-compare-sign-width.$description: VersionCompare text: the sign column's width (12px).

version-compare-added-background.$description: VersionCompare text: an added line's fill (feedback-success-soft).

version-compare-added-sign-text.$description: VersionCompare text: an added line's plus (feedback-success-content).

version-compare-removed-background.$description: VersionCompare text: a removed line's fill (feedback-danger-soft).

version-compare-removed-sign-text.$description: VersionCompare text: a removed line's minus (feedback-danger-content).

version-compare-fold-background.$description: VersionCompare text: a folded run of unchanged lines (surface-sunken).

version-compare-focus-outline-color.$description: VersionCompare text: the focus ring of the lines and of a change's first line (focus-ring-color).

version-compare-focus-outline-offset.$description: VersionCompare text: the lines' ring offset (focus-ring-offset).
